## Status

`open` | `decided YYYY-MM-DD` | `superseded by #<issue>`

## Context

What forces the decision now. The constraint, not the preference.

## Options

**A. …** — trade-off
**B. …** — trade-off

Keep each honest: name what each option costs, not only what it buys.

## Decision

The chosen option and the reasoning that actually drove it. If still `open`,
say what evidence would settle it.

## Consequences

What this makes easy, what it makes hard, and what becomes irreversible. Note
anything that would have to be unwound to change course later.

## Where it is enforced

The file, gate, or CLAUDE.md paragraph that makes this decision stick. A
decision recorded nowhere in the repo will be re-litigated by the next agent.
